title: edit-eval-question command payload

question.description: Required for create and update. The lengths keep the payload within 4 KB.

expectedAnswer.description: The facts a correct answer contains.

expectedDocumentIds.description: Documents a correct retrieval returns; empty = the question expects not found.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command edit-eval-question (processing design §13.4): creates, updates or retires a human question of the collection's evaluation set. The admin generates questionId for a create.
